name: zarin-hooshmand-functions
description: Zarin Hooshmand — Cloud Functions: RBAC provisioning, triggers, analytics engine, AI layer and n8n integration API

scripts.test:rules: cd ../.. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-zarin-rules "cd firebase/functions && npx vitest run test/rules"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && cd ../.. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-zarin "cd firebase/functions && FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-zarin node lib/seed/seed.js && npx vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mjs"
